title: [2.8.2.2 - dev] ISF lower than 2 mmol/l results in invalid profile
symptom: When setting the ISF lower than 2 mmol/l, the profile cannot be validated or saved. It was still working correctly in 2.8.2 main.
cause: The hard limit for ISF is defined in mg/dl (MIN_ISF = 2.0) and is never translated to mmol/l, causing validation to fail for values below 2 mmol/l.
fix: Added a check to convert the hard limits to mmol/l when the profile units are mmol/l, as shown in the modified isValidEditState() function.
evidence_quote: Apperently it is never translated to mmol/l. setting this limit on something lower, fixes the problem.
